# HireReady - AI-Powered Interview Preparation Platform

> HireReady is an AI-powered interview practice platform offering real-time feedback, mock interviews, aptitude tests, skill analytics, GD practice, and resume building for job seekers.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **AI Mock Interviews**: Practice technical, HR, behavioral, and DSA questions with instant voice/text NLP evaluation.
- **Aptitude Practice**: Quantitative, logical, and verbal reasoning practice tests with instant scoring and explanation breakdown.
- **Skill Radar & Analytics**: Multi-dimensional skill scorecards tracking technical, communication, and problem-solving readiness.
- **Group Discussion (GD) Lab**: Simulated GD sessions with AI persona participants and turn-by-turn feedback.
- **Resume Builder & Analyzer**: Built-in resume editor with real-time job description matching and ATS keyword optimization.
- **Community Hub**: Interactive discussion forum for interview experience sharing, interview tips, and peer advice.
